name: neon-gradient-card
title: Neon Gradient Card
description: A dark rounded card whose thin border runs a pink-to-teal gradient that slides and pulses endlessly, throwing a blurred glow onto the backdrop. The content sits untouched inside.
use: A promo or feature card should feel high-energy on an already dark page.
avoid: Light themes: the glow and gradient border wash out against pale backgrounds.
a11y: Decorative and non-interactive; the endless glow ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black rounded rectangle centred on a very dark stage. Its thin border carries a magenta-to-cyan gradient and casts a soft coloured haze onto the surrounding backdrop. Three lines of heavy gradient text fill the inside.
behaves: The gradient slides up and down the border on a slow three-second loop that alternates direction, and the blurred halo outside shifts with it. The card itself never reacts to the pointer or clicks.
customise: Border thickness, corner radius and the two neon colours are props; the inner background, padding and animation timing need a source edit.
weight: light: Two pseudo-elements driven by one CSS keyframe loop; no canvas or JS animation.
